title: Compile every spell into a clause-complete procedure
acceptance_criteria:
- Every printed deterministic spell hook is either represented and engine-mapped, or explicitly non-engine with a clause-level rationale.
- No generic metadata (concentration flag, save ability, duration) can make an incomplete spell appear complete.
- Area geometry is typed for every spell that prints one, with its origin kind.
- Upcast bases are typed and derivable, not prose-only.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
